items.t: Oklo Advances Groves-1 Reactor Into Research and Testing Phase

items.t: Can Oklo (OKLO) Be Below Fair Value After Groves Progress?

items.t: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.

items.t: OKLO Stock After Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Hold for Now?
items.sum: OKLO's $3.1 billion cash cushion supports its nuclear ambitions, but heavy spending, widening losses and uncertain commercial deals warrant investor caution.
